traits.name: Inscrutable
traits.text: Immune to any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, and to divination spells aimed at it.

traits.name: Spellcasting (Sphinx)
traits.text: WIS save DC 15. At will: Detect Magic, Identify. 1/day each: Remove Curse, Speak with Dead.

legendaryActions.name: Pounce (Cost 2)
legendaryActions.text: Move up to half speed; +1 to hit; DC 17 STR or prone + 4d6 piercing extra.

legendaryActions.name: Roar (Cost 1)
legendaryActions.text: Each enemy within 60 ft: WIS save DC 16 or frightened 1 min.
